title: Great Kitchen Tools! Great Price!
text: Great Kitchen Tools! Great Price!. I do a lot of baking and was needing a new pastry cutter. Getting the whole set was a great deal!

product_metadata.title: HULISEN Stainless Steel Pastry Scraper, Dough Blender & Biscuit Cutter Set (3 Pieces/ Set), Heavy Duty & Durable with Ergonomic Rubber Grip, Professional Baking Dough Tools, Gift Package
features: Rust Proof Material: Made of stainless steel, easy to clean & dishwasher safe. They are ideal for making pizza, pastries, doughnuts, ravioli, pasta, cookies, scones, shortcake, tarts and frying eggs.

Non-Slip Design: Stainless steel pastry scraper and dough blender have a rubber non-slip handle that is ergonomically designed for you making your bake easier. Soft grip handle could helo you do more baking without hand and wrist fatigue.
Accurate Measurments: The "inches/cm" measurements marked clearly on the surface of pastry cutter and each biscuit cutter. No more guess when you baking, you will always pick up the right one.

Meet Different Needs: Curved design for pastry blender quickly incorporate cold pieces of butter into flour and other dry ingredients. The stainless steel biscuit cutters slice biscuits evenly through dough perfectly, dia: 1 3/4, 2, 2 1/4, 2 3/4, 3 1/4 inch (4, 5, 6, 7, 8 cm).

Wonderful Gift Set: This pastry cutter set are must-have tools for pro bakers and novice. Perfect for creating beautiful cookies, precise fondant circles, perfect donuts, round sandwiches, flaky biscuits, delicious crumpets, mini cakes, tarts and so on. Presented in a lovely box, this is the perfect gift for friends and family who love to bake!
